cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises its arm to a comfortable height, performs a friendly side-to-side wrist wave, then gently lowers its arm, signaling a greeting.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: The robot extends its arm slightly forward in anticipation, then raises its hand to head height and holds it briefly as a greeting or acknowledgment, before gently lowering it to a relaxed mid-chest position.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot starts in a composed posture, performs a subtle preparatory movement, then executes a deliberate forward and downward bow, holding for respect, before gracefully returning to an upright, settled stance.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with a vertical gripper (setup), then performs a rhythmic up-and-down shaking motion with the wrist (core action), and finally subtly retracts the arm as if completing the handshake (follow-through).

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: The robot's arm gracefully rises, brings its fingertips to its lips, then extends outward in a smooth 'blowing' motion, concluding with a slight forward lean to convey affection.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot expresses love by gracefully drawing a heart shape above its head. It begins by subtly preparing, then fluidly traces the heart, and concludes with a gentle, reinforcing gesture.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The robot arm first shows anticipation, then powerfully pumps upward, holding the peak with triumphant shakes, and finally settles into a proud posture.

cue: Pump one fist downward (Success / Yes!)
description: The robot expresses triumph by tensing its arm in anticipation, then executing a sharp, powerful downward fist pump, followed by a subtle recoil and a confident settling motion.

cue: Flex one arm to show bicep (Strength)
description: The robot demonstrates strength by first tensing, then executing a powerful bicep flex with a deliberate hold at the peak, followed by a controlled release.

cue: Nod head up and down (Yes)
description: The robot executes a clear nodding motion to signify affirmation or agreement, beginning with an attentive lean, performing rhythmic up-and-down movements, and concluding with a settled pose.

cue: Scratch head lightly (Confusion)
description: The robot expresses confusion by starting with an uncertain shrug, then raises a hand to its temple for a light, varied scratch, and concludes with a thoughtful, slightly slumped posture.

cue: Tilt head slightly (Curiosity)
description: The robot expresses curiosity by starting from a neutral pose, leaning forward, then tilting its gripper (simulating a head) to one side with a slight upward adjustment, holding the pose, and finally settling gently into a thoughtful posture.

cue: Place palm over face (Facepalm / Frustration)
description: The robot expresses frustration by first slumping slightly, then deliberately bringing its palm to cover its face, holding the pose, and slowly withdrawing into a deflated posture.

cue: Point to chest with index finger (Me)
description: The robot's arm starts in a neutral, slightly lowered position, performs a subtle inward pull in anticipation, then rapidly extends to precisely point its index finger at its own chest, holds the gesture, and finally relaxes slightly.

cue: Point forward with index finger (You)
description: The robot's arm tenses slightly, then extends decisively forward to point, holds the pose to emphasize 'you', and then gently relaxes.

cue: Extend palm forward flat (Stop)
description: The robot arm prepares with a slight inward tension, then swiftly extends forward to present an open, horizontal palm at chest height, holding it to command 'stop', before a subtle retraction and settling.

cue: Raise index finger upright (One moment / Important point)
description: The robot signals for attention or to make an important point by subtly leaning forward, raising its arm with the gripper pointing upright to eye level, holding the pose, and then slowly settling back.

cue: Pat stomach lightly (Hungry / Full)
description: The robot expresses a feeling (e.g., hunger or fullness) by bringing its hand to its stomach and performing light patting motions, starting quickly and slowing down, with a thoughtful setup and follow-through.

cue: Rub both upper arms (Cold)
description: The robot hunches slightly, pulls an arm inward as if shivering, then brings its hand to its 'upper arm' area and performs a rubbing motion, concluding by settling into a huddled position to express cold.

cue: Fan face with one hand (Hot)
description: The robot tilts its head back as if overwhelmed by heat (setup), then raises a hand near the face and fans rapidly with decreasing intensity (core action), finally wiping the forehead and slumping slightly in exhaustion (follow-through).

cue: Open mouth wide and cover it (Sleepy / Yawn)
description: The robot stretches as if yawning, quickly covers its mouth with its hand, then slowly lowers its arm and slumps, conveying sleepiness.

cue: Rub one eye (Tired)
description: The robot conveys tiredness by first slumping slightly, then slowly reaching its hand to its eye and performing a gentle rubbing motion, before slowly withdrawing and settling back into a tired posture.

cue: Bow deeply while hands at sides (Apology)
description: The robot expresses apology by first drooping its arm in humility, then performing a deep, slow bow with hands remaining at its sides, holding the lowest point, and finally rising slowly to a subdued posture.

cue: Raise both hands and flex index and middle fingers twice (Air quotes)
description: The robot subtly leans forward in skepticism, then raises one arm to a mid-front position with the gripper vertical. It performs two rapid 'air quote' gestures using wrist flexion, each with a subtle arm emphasis. The motion concludes with the arm slowly lowering while briefly holding the implied 'quote' expression. (Note: This configuration is for a single arm, intended to be mirrored for a second arm in a dual-arm setup for a complete 'air quotes' gesture.)

cue: Slide index finger across lips like zipping (Secret / Won’t tell)
description: The robot brings its index finger to the left corner of its mouth, slides it horizontally across the lips to the right like zipping, and finishes with a locking flick, signaling a secret or unwillingness to tell.

cue: Lean forward slightly with palms open (Interest)
description: The robot prepares with a subtle drop, then leans its body forward with an extended arm, orienting its gripper to signify 'open palms' as an expression of interest or invitation, before settling into a slightly recessed pose.

cue: Step back slightly with both palms raised outward (Shock / Surprise)
description: The robot leans slightly forward in anticipation, then sharply recoils backward, raising its arms with palms outward to express shock or surprise, holding the pose, and finally settling its arms slowly.

cue: Cover mouth with palm (Gasp / Oops)
description: The robot leans forward slightly in anticipation (setup), then quickly recoils as its hand flies to cover its mouth and holds a shocked expression (core action), finally slowly lowering the hand and regaining composure (follow-through).

cue: Press palms together and bow slightly (Thank you / Respect)
description: The robot brings its gripper 'hands' together in front of its chest, then slowly bows its arm forward to express gratitude or respect, holding the pose, and gracefully returning to a composed position.

cue: Extend one fist forward (Asking for fist bump)
description: The robot's arm first subtly tenses and pulls inward in anticipation, then rapidly extends a clenched fist directly forward for a fist bump, holds it steady, and finally eases its extension slightly while maintaining the forward gesture.

cue: Pat your own back (Encouragement)
description: The robot expresses self-encouragement by briefly tensing and pulling its arm inward, then reaching around to its own upper back to pat it rhythmically, concluding with a confident posture adjustment.

cue: Draw a circle in the air with index finger (Repeat / Around)
description: The robot extends its arm forward and slightly upward to prepare, then its wrist draws multiple small circles in the air to symbolize 'repeat' or 'around', concluding by gently lowering the arm.

cue: Slice flat hand horizontally across throat (Cut / Stop it)
description: The robot brings a flat hand to the side of its throat and performs a quick, decisive horizontal slicing motion, conveying a strong command to 'cut it out' or 'stop'.

cue: Swipe back of fingers outward from under chin (Dismissive / Whatever)
description: The robot expresses dismissal or disinterest by tensing slightly, bringing the back of its hand under its chin, and then performing a sharp outward flick, followed by a relaxed, lowered posture.

cue: Drum fingers on table or in air (Waiting / Bored)
description: The robot subtly leans forward, positions its hand as if over a table, performs a sequence of finger-drumming actions that slow over time, and finishes with a bored slump.

cue: Turn palm upward and curl fingers inward (Give me)
description: The robot leans forward slightly in anticipation, extends its arm with the palm facing upward, then performs a rapid, repetitive finger-curling motion that gradually slows, concluding with a settled, open-hand posture to signify 'give me' or 'come here'.

cue: Extend open palm upward steadily (Offering)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral ready position, steadily extends forward and upward with the palm open, holds this offering pose, and then subtly settles back.

cue: Cover both ears (Too loud / Don’t want to hear)
description: The robot anticipates a loud noise by tensing and slowly raising its arm, then quickly brings its hand to the side of its head to cover an ear, holding the position with a slight tremor, and finally slowly lowers the arm in a gesture of discomfort or relief.

cue: Open both arms wide outward (Welcome)
description: The robot's arm starts in a neutral position, then performs a preparatory lift. It sweeps wide and slightly upward, extending forward with the gripper horizontal, holding this welcoming posture, and finally settles slightly from its full extension.

cue: Stretch both arms upward (Relief / Stretch)
description: The robot slowly raises both arms high above its head, extending them fully, holds the stretch with a slight sway, and then gently lowers them to convey relief or a satisfying stretch.

cue: Bring one hand to forehead in salute position (Salute)
description: The robot executes a formal salute gesture: first, an anticipatory tension, then a crisp snap to the forehead with a fine adjustment, a hold at attention, and a dignified follow-through.

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot prepares to engage with a slight anticipatory shift, then extends its arm forward with the gripper oriented vertically, holding a clear handshake pose, and concludes with a subtle settling.

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot's arm starts slightly open, pulls in briefly, then sweeps across its chest to hug itself, holding the embrace, and finally uncrosses and settles downwards, conveying a feeling of comfort.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot arm moves inward and upward to gently place its hand over its chest, holding it there to convey sincerity or gratitude, followed by a subtle release.

cue: Shake head side to side (No)
description: The robot lifts its arm to near its temple, then performs several distinct side-to-side oscillations to convey 'no', concluding with a subtle lowering of the arm.

cue: Shrug shoulders with palms up (I don’t know)
description: The robot expresses 'I don't know' by tensing, swiftly shrugging its shoulder with palms up, holding briefly, and then slowly relaxing the arm with a subtle outward push.

cue: Turn palm downward and curl fingers inward repeatedly (Come here / Beckon)
description: The robot extends its arm, rotates its wrist to present a downward-facing palm, then repeatedly curls its fingers inward in a 'come here' gesture, finishing with a relaxed retraction.

cue: Place index finger on lips (Shh / Be quiet)
description: The robot leans forward slightly to convey discretion (setup), then quickly raises its hand to press an index finger against its lips, holding the 'shh' gesture (core action), before gently withdrawing the hand and settling into a composed posture (follow-through).

cue: Tap temple with index finger (Think / Smart)
description: The robot leans forward slightly in contemplation, raises its arm to the temple and performs several quick taps, holds the final tap, then slowly lowers its hand and settles.

cue: Rotate index finger near temple (Crazy)
description: The robot raises its hand to the temple, performs circular rotations with the wrist to convey 'crazy' or 'thinking too hard', then slowly withdraws the hand.

cue: Cross arms over chest (Defensive)
description: The robot arm initially pulls inward with tension, then sweeps decisively across its chest to a firm, held position, conveying a defensive or closed-off stance.

cue: Place both hands on hips (Confidence / Annoyed)
description: The robot adopts a slightly tense posture, then moves its arm to its hip, firmly placing the gripper against it, and concludes with a subtle emphatic push to convey confidence or annoyance.

cue: Raise one hand as if holding an invisible glass (Cheers)
description: The robot's arm smoothly lifts from a resting position to present an open gripper as if holding a glass, performs a subtle upward 'clink' motion, and then settles into a proud, held pose to convey a 'cheers' gesture.

cue: Raise one palm upward as if inviting a high five (Asking for high five)
description: The robot prepares with a subtle retracting movement, then sweeps its arm upward and forward, presenting an open palm for a high five, holding the gesture briefly before a slight, natural settling. This conveys an invitation or request for interaction.

cue: Swing one raised palm downward as if high-fiving air (Imitating high five)
description: The robot prepares by subtly tensing, then raises its arm high with an open palm. It swiftly swings the arm downward in a high-five motion, followed by a slight recoil and a relaxed settling. This cue communicates enthusiasm, agreement, or an imitation of a high-five gesture.

cue: Tap one fist lightly against your other palm (Imitating fist bump)
description: The robot prepares its arm, approaches an imaginary palm position in front of its body, performs a quick initial tap followed by a softer, lingering tap, then withdraws and settles.

cue: Raise both hands beside head (I give up / Surrender)
description: The robot's arm subtly slumps in resignation (setup), then slowly rises to a position beside its head with the gripper opening facing forward, holding the pose (core action), and finally lowers slightly in a deflated manner (follow-through), embodying the gesture of 'I give up' with a single arm.

cue: Place one hand above eyebrows as visor and look far (Searching distance)
description: The robot gestures as if searching the horizon by forming a visor with its hand, indicating a focused search or looking far away.
